## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, lint, and TypeScript checks pass
- [ ] Relevant unit or component tests pass
- [ ] Geographic invariants pass when preset data changed
- [ ] Critical Playwright journeys pass when user behavior changed
- [ ] Production build passes

## Product checks

- [ ] Keyboard and focus behavior remain accessible
- [ ] Light and dark themes remain legible
- [ ] Persistent data remains backward compatible or includes a migration
- [ ] Geographic sources and attribution are documented when data changed
